instruction.name: x86mfflag
instruction.description: Read selected x86 flags from EFLAGS, as determined by mask, and pack them into rd.

operands.name: mask
operands.description: flag-selection mask (0x3f selects CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, OF)

experiments.name: EFLAGS -> rd
experiments.notes: Total = L(x86mtflag) + L(x86mfflag) = 4.00; L(x86mtflag) = 3.00, so L(x86mfflag) = 1.00.

latencies.notes: Measured with x86mtflag as the reverse edge.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mfflag $r12, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r13, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r14, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r15, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r16, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r17, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r18, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r19, 0x3f
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 10000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 0x3f' --asm 'x86mfflag $r12, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r13, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r14, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r15, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r16, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r17, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r18, 0x3f; x86mfflag $r19, 0x3f'
throughput.notes: 8 instructions take 8.01 cycles: 1.00 cycle per instruction.

notes: Latency 1 cycle(s) and throughput 1 CPI for the operand combination(s) recorded above, measured with ./bench on LA664.
